capabilities: Drag rows or use move buttons to arrange notes in a custom order
Save the order as a numeric rank property in note frontmatter
Choose a table layout with links and properties or a compact list layout
Respect base filters and groups so moves stay within the current group
Configure per-view custom rank properties with the paid Pro tier
extras: Freemium: ordering with the manual_order property is free with no row limit; Pro (custom rank property per view) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($15 once or $5/month) verified by device-flow sign-in that queries sponsorship tier but sends no vault data. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. No undo history; failed writes stop and attempt rollback. Does not add handles to built-in Bases tables.
intentEvidence: Bases Manual Order adds a view to Bases with a table layout and a compact list layout.
motivation: The README says a queue often needs a judgment that a date or title cannot express, and numeric ranks keep those choices usable in other Bases views.
problem: Bases can only sort by property values like dates or titles, which cannot express a hand-chosen queue order for reading lists or writing queues.
summary: Bases view plugin that adds a table or list view where rows can be dragged into a manual order stored as a numeric note property.
